_meta.source: AWS Lambda Developer Guide, 2022 edition (last release 11/28/2022), abbreviation LAMBDA
_meta.note: Portuguese keywords are kept on purpose: lambda_lookup.py still recognizes Portuguese queries; English keywords were added.

topics.name: What Lambda is and when to use it
topics.summary: Event-driven compute service: you upload code and Lambda runs it, scales it and bills per use. Features: functions, triggers, events, execution environment, runtimes, layers, extensions, concurrency, qualifiers, destinations.
topics.gaps: Pricing: the text only points to an external pricing page.

topics.name: Core concepts
topics.summary: Definitions: function, trigger, event, execution environment, instruction set architecture, deployment package, runtime, layer, extension, concurrency, qualifier, destination.

topics.name: Programming model and handler
topics.summary: Model common to all runtimes: the handler receives an event and a context; the runtime invokes the handler and returns the response; Runtime API/runtime interface client.

topics.name: arm64 vs x86_64
topics.summary: Architecture choice per function; suggested arm64 migration steps and code/dependency compatibility.

topics.name: Execution environment lifecycle
topics.summary: Init, Invoke and Shutdown phases; environment reuse across invocations; cold start = creation + init; freezing between invocations.

topics.name: VPC, Hyperplane ENIs and connectivity
topics.summary: Function attached to private subnets through managed ENIs (Hyperplane); internet access requires NAT; AWS services via VPC endpoints; IAM condition keys for VPC; SG/subnet limits.

topics.name: EFS and RDS Proxy
topics.summary: EFS mounted through an access point requires a VPC; RDS Proxy manages a connection pool for relational databases.

topics.name: Execution role and credentials
topics.summary: Role assumed by the function; least privilege; managed policies such as AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole; temporary credentials in the environment; condition key lambda:SourceFunctionArn.

topics.name: Resource-based policies (who can invoke)
topics.summary: AddPermission grants access to services, organizations (PrincipalOrgId) and other accounts; source-arn/source-account prevent the confused deputy; applies to function, version, alias and layer.

topics.name: User policies, ABAC and boundaries
topics.summary: IAM actions and resources for Lambda, condition keys (VPC, tags), tag-based ABAC, permissions boundaries.

topics.name: Security: data protection, IAM, compliance
topics.summary: Shared responsibility; encryption in transit/at rest; IAM; resilience (AZs, versions, scaling); minimum TLS.

topics.name: Supported runtimes and deprecation
topics.summary: 2022 edition runtime table (nodejs18.x ... provided.al2), OS (AL2/AL), architectures; two-phase deprecation policy (phase 1: no patches and no creation; phase 2: no updates).
topics.datado: the WHOLE runtime table and deprecation dates

topics.name: Custom runtimes and Runtime API
topics.summary: provided/provided.al2 + bootstrap; Runtime API (next invocation, response, init error, invocation error); tutorial with a layer.

topics.name: Extensions, Extensions API, Telemetry API, Logs API
topics.summary: Processes that run alongside the runtime (internal/external); their own lifecycle; Extensions API; Telemetry/Logs API to ship telemetry to destinations; performance and cost impact.
topics.datado: API versions and buffering values (the text has divergent tables)

topics.name: Deploy .zip and container images
topics.summary: Two package types: .zip and container image (ECR); AWS base images, RIC, RIE; image requirements; create/update via console, CLI, CloudFormation, SAM.
topics.datado: maximum sizes (50 MB zip / 250 MB / 10 GB image)

topics.name: Layers
topics.summary: Shared .zip archives mounted at /opt; versioned; permission per account/organization; maximum of 5 per function [DATED].

topics.name: Code signing and tags
topics.summary: Package signing with AWS Signer and a validation policy; tags for ABAC and organization.

topics.name: Memory, timeout and ephemeral storage
topics.summary: Memory 128-10,240 MB (proportional CPU; 1,769 MB = 1 vCPU), default timeout 3 s and maximum 900 s, /tmp 512-10,240 MB [DATED].

topics.name: Environment variables
topics.summary: String pairs per version; aggregate limit of 4 KB; reserved keys; encryption at rest with KMS; secrets in Secrets Manager.

topics.name: Versions and aliases
topics.summary: A published version is immutable; an alias points to a version (not to an alias); routing config splits traffic between up to two versions; permission on the alias does not apply to the version.

topics.name: Concurrency: model, reserved, provisioned, burst
topics.summary: Concurrency = RPS x duration; reserved = ceiling + guarantee (no cost; 0 blocks); provisioned = pre-initialized environments (cost; on a version/alias); burst 500-3000 + 500/min [DATED].
topics.datado: 1,000 per account; 900 reservable; burst per region

topics.name: Synchronous invocation
topics.summary: RequestResponse: the caller waits for the response and decides the retry; function errors arrive in the X-Amz-Function-Error header.

topics.name: Asynchronous invocation, DLQ and destinations
topics.summary: Event is queued; 2 retries (1 min, 2 min); up to 6 h for throttle/5xx; DLQ (SQS/SNS) or destinations (SQS, SNS, Lambda, EventBridge) for success/failure [DATED].

topics.name: Event source mapping, batching and filters
topics.summary: Resource that reads from a queue/stream and invokes the function; batching by size/window; FilterCriteria filters; function states.

topics.name: Errors and retries per model
topics.summary: Invocation error vs function error; synchronous: caller decides; asynchronous: Lambda retries 2x; stream: retries the batch and blocks the shard; queue: visibility timeout and redrive.

topics.name: Function URLs
topics.summary: Dedicated HTTPS endpoint; auth type AWS_IAM or NONE; CORS; throttling; payload in HTTP event format.

topics.name: SQS as a source
topics.summary: Polling with batch; visibility timeout >= 6x function timeout; DLQ on the queue; ReportBatchItemFailures; FIFO max batch 10.

topics.name: Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams
topics.summary: Streams read per shard; batch retry blocks the shard; bisect, max age/retries, on-failure destination, tumbling window, ParallelizationFactor.

topics.name: Kafka, MSK and Amazon MQ
topics.summary: Consumer group created by Lambda; 14 min maximum timeout for these sources; authentication and networking (VPC); an error repeats the batch.

topics.name: S3, SNS, API Gateway, EventBridge and others
topics.summary: Services that invoke Lambda (synchronously or asynchronously) via resource-based policy: API Gateway, S3, SNS, EventBridge/schedules, CloudTrail, ALB, CloudFront (Lambda@Edge), etc.

topics.name: SnapStart (Java 11)
topics.summary: Snapshot of the initialized function when a version is published; resume instead of init; up to 10x less startup; java11 only, published versions only; no PC/arm64/EFS/X-Ray/ephemeral>512 MB; uniqueness and runtime hooks (CRaC).
topics.gaps: No other runtimes, no region list.

topics.name: Handlers, logging, errors and tracing per language
topics.summary: Common pattern documented once (Node.js) + differences per language (TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Java, Go, C#/.NET, PowerShell).

topics.name: Monitoring: metrics, logs, Insights, X-Ray
topics.summary: AWS/Lambda metrics (Invocations, Errors, Duration, Throttles, ConcurrentExecutions, IteratorAge...), CloudWatch Logs, Lambda Insights, CodeGuru Profiler, X-Ray.

topics.name: Troubleshooting
topics.summary: Common causes: permission, undefined handler, ResourceConflict, function stuck in Pending, recursion, cold starts with PC, EFS, VPC without internet, ENI limit, container.

topics.name: Applications, SAM, CodeDeploy and Step Functions
topics.summary: Lambda applications (CloudFormation/SAM), rolling deployments, orchestration with Step Functions and error handling.

topics.name: Best practices
topics.summary: Environment reuse, idempotency, avoiding recursion, memory/timeout by testing, least privilege, alarms, batch tuning and IteratorAge.

topics.name: Quotas and limits
topics.summary: Table of compute/storage, configuration/deploy/execution and API requests (2022 edition).

topics.name: API reference (parameters and errors)
topics.summary: Ranges and enums per parameter (MemorySize, Timeout, BatchSize, MaximumRetryAttempts...), status codes and errors per action, Marker/NextMarker pagination.

topics.name: Releases and edition date
topics.summary: Change history up to 11/28/2022 (SnapStart for Java) - proof of the edition date; "earlier updates" since 2014.
topics.datado: everything after Nov/2022 is outside the text
